name: NovaTutor
release: GATE CSE test-series answer-state and scoring fix
scope: Fixes per-question answer persistence and corrupted negative scoring in the GATE CSE full-length test series. Uses a unique per-attempt question key instead of reused question-bank numbers. No AI Teacher or other module behavior changes.
title: GATE CSE Subject Question Counts + Result Breakdown Fix
changes: Subject overview cards show actual question-bank count per individual CSE subject.
Subject result breakdown now shows correct/total questions, with correct+wrong+unattempted totaling that subject's questions.
GATE test history key bumped to isolate older result records.
